kurals.tr: Insolaal Eeram Alaiip Patiruilavaam / Semporul Kantaarvaaich Chol
kurals.m: Sweet words are those which imbued with love and free from deceit flow from the mouth of the virtuous

kurals.tr: Akanamarndhu Eedhalin Nandre Mukanamarndhu / Insolan Aakap Perin
kurals.m: Sweet speech, with a cheerful countenance is better than a gift made with a joyous mind

kurals.tr: Mukaththaan Amarndhuinidhu Nokki Akaththaanaam / Inso Linadhe Aram
kurals.m: Sweet speech, flowing from the heart (uttered) with a cheerful countenance and a sweet look, is true virtue

kurals.tr: Thunpurooum Thuvvaamai Illaakum Yaarmaattum / Inpurooum Inso Lavarkku
kurals.m: Sorrow-increasing poverty shall not come upon those who use towards all, pleasure-increasing sweetness of speech

kurals.tr: Panivutaiyan Insolan Aadhal Oruvarku / Aniyalla Matrup Pira
kurals.m: Humility and sweetness of speech are the ornaments of man; all others are not (ornaments)

kurals.tr: Allavai Theya Aramperukum Nallavai / Naati Iniya Solin
kurals.m: If a man, while seeking to speak usefully, speaks also sweetly, his sins will diminish and his virtue increase

kurals.tr: Nayan Eendru Nandri Payakkum / Payaneendru Panpin Thalaippiriyaach Chol
kurals.m: That speech which, while imparting benefits ceases not to please, will yield righteousness (for this world) and merit (for the next world)

kurals.tr: Sirumaiyul Neengiya Insol Marumaiyum / Immaiyum Inpam Tharum
kurals.m: Sweet speech, free from harm to others, will give pleasure both in this world and in the next

kurals.tr: Insol Inidheendral Kaanpaan Evankolo / Vansol Vazhangu Vadhu?
kurals.m: Why does he use harsh words, who sees the pleasure which sweet speech yields ?

kurals.tr: Iniya Ulavaaka Innaadha Kooral / Kaniiruppak Kaaikavarn Thatru
kurals.m: To say disagreeable things when agreeable are at hand is like eating unripe fruit when there is ripe
